highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156 brings Skia m156, native GTK4 GPU views and Uno 7 support.
highlights_body: This line restores Linux NoDependencies font discovery, improves rendering and resource lifetimes, and paces Android continuous rendering to display refresh. Review the GTK coordinate changes, platform minimums and stricter input validation before upgrading.

breaking.title: Choose GTK4 paint coordinates explicitly
breaking.body: SKDrawingArea now paints in physical pixels by default on high-density displays, matching the new SKGLArea. Set IgnorePixelScaling=true to retain logical paint coordinates while keeping full-resolution backing storage. GTK input coordinates remain logical; RawInfo always describes physical pixels.

breaking.title: Move Uno views to Uno 7 and .NET 10
breaking.body: The non-Windows Uno views require Uno Platform 7 and .NET 10. SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid, uses a CPU canvas and reports a null GRContext; use SKCanvasElement for GPU rendering. Remove RaiseOnUnsupported usages. Migrate pre-Uno 7 WasmShell pipelines to the .NET SDK WebAssembly path; Uno.Sdk supplies platform native assets. The Windows facade remains ANGLE-backed.

breaking.title: Raise Apple deployment targets
breaking.body: SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp native libraries now require macOS 12 or iOS, tvOS and Mac Catalyst 15. Raise application deployment targets accordingly, retaining any higher framework minimum. The earlier macOS 11 and iOS/tvOS 14 native floors were superseded by the Xcode 27 support update; .NET 9 targets remain available.

breaking.title: Upgrade Tizen consumers to Tizen 10
breaking.body: The new native builds and NativeAssets packages no longer support Tizen 8 or 9. Move applications to Tizen 10 and the net10.0-tizen10.0 package targets. Native source builds require GCC 14.2 and support x64 and arm64 rather than the former 32-bit or Clang paths.

breaking.title: Use rebuilt archives for newer WebAssembly consumers
breaking.body: Newer WebAssembly consumers require archives containing emdawnwebgpu's C++ support; pre-change or GPU-disabled custom archives do not satisfy that link contract. Rebuild custom archives instead of passing webgpu.cpp and C++ flags at application link time. JavaScript glue remains a consumer link input, and the .NET 8 built-in WebGPU path is retained.

breaking.title: Pass valid encoded text and data lengths
breaking.body: Encoded font APIs now throw ArgumentOutOfRangeException for negative byte lengths and ArgumentException for odd GlyphId byte counts. SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the length exceeds the array. Supply complete 16-bit glyph IDs and lengths within the source buffer. Encoded BreakText results count bytes; string and char-span results count UTF-16 code units.

breaking.title: Use one encoded unit for character-code conversion
breaking.body: StringUtilities.GetUnicodeCharacterCode now requires exactly one encoded unit: ASCII for Utf8, one UTF-16 unit for Utf16, or one Unicode code point for Utf32. Choose Utf32 for supplementary characters; multi-character and multi-unit inputs throw ArgumentException. GetString(byte[], SKTextEncoding) now throws ArgumentNullException rather than NullReferenceException for null arrays.

breaking.title: Replace the retired fork-specific WinRT target
breaking.body: The native fork-specific WinRT target is retired. Move consumers of that target to a supported Windows integration; desktop Windows, WinUI/Windows App SDK and NanoServer remain supported.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 156 without adding C bridge exports. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.100 while its native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.4.0.

Adds SKGLArea with PaintSurface, CanvasSize, GRContext, EnableRenderLoop and IgnorePixelScaling. GTK owns the GL context; use QueueRender to invalidate. Manually bundled GTK runtimes must include libepoxy. The new view has no automatic CPU fallback.

bullets.lead: Linux font discovery and shaping coexistence
bullets.detail: Restores installed-font discovery in Linux NoDependencies builds without adding fontconfig. Separately, binds bundled HarfBuzz's internal Linux calls locally to prevent incompatible system HarfBuzz functions from being selected after GTK loads them.

Automatic GLTextureView and MAUI Android SKGLView render loops follow Choreographer display callbacks instead of swap throughput. Explicit render requests remain independent, rendering stays on the GL worker, and pause, resize and reattachment retain synchronous progress.

bullets.lead: Safer paths, regions and shader execution
bullets.detail: Corrects convex antialiased path rasterization at clip boundaries and budgets region storage for subdivided conics. Rejects shader slot-count overflow and invalid runtime-effect types, and prevents execution of partially constructed runtime-shader pipelines.

bullets.lead: Correct GPU clips and glyph replay
bullets.detail: Corrects Ganesh path bounds and coverage-mask clamping, Graphite clip keys and stroke bounds, and inverse-fill clipping. Validates direct-mask Slug data and replay offsets, preserves creation-time rounding and rendering fallbacks, and guards oversized glyph allocations.

Corrects invalid BGRA-as-RGBx uploads on GLES and Graphite alpha-to-RGBx readback row stepping. Reflected transforms no longer enlarge zero-length hairline square caps, and rounded atlas indices prevent ordinary and LCD text from sampling the wrong texture.

bullets.lead: Native callbacks use the correct boolean widths
bullets.detail: Uses one-byte values for Skia C bool callbacks and four-byte values for HarfBuzz hb_bool_t callbacks, including false-returning glyph-name callbacks. Public delegates remain bool-based; this addresses ABI mismatches including Apple ARM64 interpreter callbacks.

Avoids an intermediate SKData allocation when copying valid managed image pixels, pools HarfBuzzSharp AddUtf32 string encoding buffers and avoids native feature-string allocation. Existing pixel validation, UTF-32 encoding and feature-string decoding behavior are preserved.

bullets.lead: Release custom fonts and borrowed streams correctly
bullets.detail: DWriteCore custom-font data is released after the last dependent typeface clone is disposed. Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream drops its reference to a borrowed stream without disposing that stream; its caller still owns disposal. This fixes retention, not backing-data lifetime.

Unbinds an EGL surface from its own current context before destroying it so Windows MAUI views can be collected. Also retains the module behind cached WGL pointers, corrects optional stream callbacks and XPS COM ownership, and disposes GTK raster surfaces before their Cairo pixel storage.

SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now both select Emscripten 6.0.2 archives for .NET 11 and later, retaining 3.1.34 for .NET 8 and 3.1.56 for .NET 9/10. Single-threaded, multithreaded and SIMD variants remain available.

Aligns library dependencies with Windows App SDK 1.7 for MAUI 9/10 without changing the declared Windows runtime minimum, and updates bundled ANGLE to chromium/8118. Source-built native imports recognize portable win-x86, win-x64 and win-arm64 RIDs in place of legacy win10-* selection.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery, moved WebGPU C++ support into WASM archives and rebuilt Uno views for Uno 7.
contributor_summaries.akoeplinger: Corrected issue-author mentions and disabled dependency automation on the Azure DevOps mirror.
contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Fixed Linux HarfBuzz symbol preemption and made Blazor CPU sample captures wait for the first paint.
contributor_summaries.dalexsoto: Updated terminology and reviewed contextual policy-check findings without changing runtime behavior.

preview_summaries.v4.156.0-rc.1.26553.11: The release candidate adds Uno 7 support, display-paced Android rendering and font, stream and callback lifetime fixes. It raises Apple minimums to macOS 12 and iOS, tvOS and Mac Catalyst 15, and tightens encoded-input validation.
preview_summaries.v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10: Preview 1 introduces Skia m156, GTK4 GPU views and restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery. GTK painting defaults to physical pixels, .NET 11 receives matching WASM assets, and new Tizen packages require Tizen 10.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100 retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0. It reduces allocations in AddUtf32 and feature formatting, corrects callback boolean widths, and aligns Apple, Tizen and .NET 11 WebAssembly requirements with the co-shipping packages.

v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.headline: Preview 1 introduces Skia m156, GTK4 GPU rendering and restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery.
v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.body: GTK4 painting now defaults to physical pixels; enable IgnorePixelScaling for logical coordinates. WebAssembly assets align with .NET 11, and Tizen packages require Tizen 10.

v4.156.0-rc.1.26553.11.headline: The release candidate adds Uno 7 support and corrects font, stream and callback lifetimes.
v4.156.0-rc.1.26553.11.body: It also paces Android rendering to display refresh, tightens input validation and corrects Linux HarfBuzz symbol preemption. Apple libraries now require macOS 12 or iOS, tvOS and Mac Catalyst 15.
